title: The Weaver of Runes
description: A translucent hooded figure weaves glowing runes into fabric on an ornate wooden loom inside a dark stone chamber. The workspace features an open book of diagrams, scattered tools, a lit candle, and t-shirts with symbols hanging on graffiti-covered brick walls under an aurora-lit night sky visible through arched windows.
prompt: A translucent hooded figure stands at an ornate wooden loom in a dark medieval stone chamber, weaving glowing white runes and symbols into sheer fabric that flows across the room, one hand touching the loom while the other rests on the table, foreground shows a large open book with diagrams, scattered tools, a lit candle in a mug, and a t-shirt with intricate circular patterns laid out, background features brick walls covered in white graffiti and hanging t-shirts with symbols, arched windows reveal a green and purple aurora borealis in the night sky, mystical and atmospheric fantasy scene
